Please use the following email to report a bug or issue with the model and the support team will get back to you shortly.
    Please include the model name, a brief description of the issue, and the website link to the policy the issue relates to.

ihs_score.description: The scope of the event(s) is broadening across the country. Major disruption of commercial activity in parts of the country.

industry.description: Industry thought not to be at high risk and does not have a track record of activity.
industry.uw_rationale: Mainly industrial risk around Sri Lanka away from city centre, does include a few hotels including the Cinnamon hotel which had a USD 450k loss in 2021 from easter bombings, but now below deductible for us

policy.description: English Law and jurisdiction (or equivalent), standard wordings, terms and conditions.
policy.uw_rationale: Local L&J - Good PD deductible, but still fully exposed to BI

security.description: Security and risk mitigation are at industry standard.
security.uw_rationale: Security guards at hotels and controlled access to sites, but not much better than we would expect for average risk in Sri Lanka

rationale.help_file: User Guide, Quick Starts, Training Videos are stored [here](https://beazley.sharepoint.com/sites/ActuarialPricing).

standard_fields.uw_rationale: Liberty are expiring lead, and again renewed as lead this year. Was told by other brokers that this risk was desked by the winning insurer, and then they had to pay for this insurance out of their own pocket, as they promised the client they could place it at LKR 10bn, and therefore expect a difficult renewal in 2025. Risk is ok, but there is so many locations covered that makes it exposed to potential proximity losses, which is why we only indicated a 7.5% line ($6m). LSM lead with 30% line
